title: AICity
tagline: We make it dead simple to launch your own pop up city. It is Ethereum and AI agent native.
description: We make it dead simple to launch your own pop up city. All you have to do is describe the name, location, mission statement, start and end date. It's easy to make a residency inside of it. Create a residency with a link to a listing (e.g. on AirBnB), list out the prices of each room, a deadline and min and maximum number of people to join each residency. When it's reached, then the funds can be released to the boundary. For the hardware POC, each residency comes with a visual dashboard that displays key information, number of residents, treasury balance, time until start and end date. Residents can access the phsyical space by unlocking the door with their Ethereum wallet, which we demonstrate using an air gapped raspberry pi zero wallet
how_its_made: It's made with world ID as the human human and over 18 age verification and supplied on Ethereum mainnet uses smart contracts for the launching a city and launching a residency it uses Raspberry Pi for for the dashboard visualization that displays all the data in real time and uses a servo as a lock for the door and the Raspberry Pi 0 for the airgapped wallet.
auto_summary: A web and smart-contract system for creating pop-up cities and residencies, handling residency escrow, identity-gated access, and Raspberry Pi door/dashboard integrations.
